text: You turn 40. A card says you're "not old, just vintage". You keep it, and hate it.

risk.result: The party was actually less risky.

death.cause: You did not make it down in one piece.

text: There's a red convertible in the showroom window. It knows your name.

right.label: Buy it
right.result: It rains for the next five months.

up.label: Buy it and do a road trip

risk.result: The car is faster than your nerves.

death.cause: The bend was sharper than the sign said.

text: The menu has got smaller. All menus have got smaller.

risk.result: The laser had a bad day.

text: Your knee now predicts the weather, with more accuracy than the forecast.

up.label: Run a half marathon on it

risk.result: The knee has the final word.

text: A letter invites you for a routine screening. It uses the word "just" four times.

risk.result: They find it later than they should have. The treatment is hard.

right.label: Go
right.result: All clear. You treat yourself to a sandwich.

risk.result: They find a thing you now worry about.

text: The nurse pumps the cuff twice, frowns, and asks about your week.

right.label: Cut the salt and walk more

risk.result: You are hungry and unbearable.

text: There's a tight feeling in your chest on the stairs. It's probably nothing.

death.cause: a heart attack on the stairs

risk.result: You wake up in a hospital with a stent.

right.label: Go to the ER
right.result: They catch it in time. A doctor uses the phrase "wake-up call".

risk.result: You are in no state to drive.

death.cause: The chest pain was not nothing.

text: A parent has started repeating the same story. You've heard it three times this visit.

risk.result: You hear all of them. Again.

text: A parent can't manage alone any more, and the care home brochure has a lot of smiling in it.

up.label: Move them in and quit work

risk.result: It is a lot harder than the brochure.

text: The funeral's on Friday. Somebody needs to say a few words, and everybody looks at you.

right.label: Say them
right.result: You get through it. Then you find their handwriting on a shopping list.

up.label: Give a eulogy that has everybody laughing

risk.result: One joke lands badly.

text: A friend from your twenties died. You find out from a post, between two adverts.

right.label: Call the old group

risk.result: It didn't go to plan.

right.result: You promise to meet more than at funerals.

up.label: Travel to the funeral and meet the old group

risk.result: Everyone drinks. Everyone cries.

text: The promotion went to someone who was born the year you started working.

risk.result: You have no other job to resign into.

text: An email invites you to a meeting about "exciting changes". It's from HR, with a box of tissues.

risk.result: You keep the job. You lose your desk, your team and your window.
They found a way to say no.

text: Work has a new system. The twenty-three-year-old explaining it is being very gentle with you.

risk.result: The advanced course is for people who already know.

text: Your pension statement has arrived. There's a graph, and it's not a nice shape.

up.label: Move everything into a risky fund

risk.result: The fund had a bad quarter. Then another.

text: A man on the radio says it isn't too late to get rich. His seminar is $2,000.

risk.result: You paid for it later.
The main lesson is to run seminars.
The VIP tier has a free tote bag.

text: A doctor says you need more exercise. The local swimming pool has a slow lane.

right.label: Join the slow lane
right.result: Everyone in it has opinions about the fast lane.

risk.result: You haven't swum in a very long time.

text: You've got time on your weekends again. There's a choir, or a shed.

right.label: The choir
right.result: You're told to mime the high bits.

up.label: Do both and run the whole show

risk.result: You are now in charge of the raffle.

text: Your school bully friends you online. They've found peace, and they'd like to talk about it.

right.label: Hear them out
right.result: They don't remember the thing you've remembered for thirty years.

risk.result: You are surprised how much it hurts.

text: A local college wants people to mentor students in your line of work.

risk.result: It is a lot more than three.

text: You've gone up a size. The shop assistant calls it "relaxed fit".

risk.result: You are not a nice person on day two.

text: Your hairline has moved out without telling you.

risk.result: It comes back in a straight line. People look at it.
The result is... not what the brochure said.

text: A clinic promises to take ten years off your face. Your face would have to stay very still.

risk.result: You look permanently surprised, which is at least honest.
You can't blink right for a week.

text: You could retrain and do what you wanted to do at twenty. Everyone says you're mad.

risk.result: The course costs more than you thought.

text: A distant aunt has left you some money, and also a large collection of spoons.

up.label: Spend it all on one big thing

risk.result: Money has a way of leaving.

text: You're invited to a party that starts at nine. At night.

right.label: Go
right.result: You leave at ten and feel wonderful about it.

risk.result: You pay for it all week.

text: The doctor asks how much you drink. You halve it. The doctor doubles it.

risk.result: It is harder than you thought.

text: You're awake at 4am again, thinking about something you said in 1998.

risk.result: The coach sleeps better than you.

text: Someone young is crying at the bus stop, and pretending not to.

right.label: Ask if they're all right
right.result: They're fine. They tell you anyway, and the bus comes twice.

up.label: Sit with them till they're okay

risk.result: They're grateful. You're late for everything.

text: You've started counting the years to retirement. You have an app for it.

right.label: Check it at lunch
right.result: It has a little countdown, and a confetti setting.

risk.result: The numbers do not add up.
